dialogues.speaker: Isami
dialogues.text: That mercenary... shouldn't be a bad person, right? This place is just full of plants, so there's nothing worth taking for him.

dialogues.speaker: Isami
dialogues.text: Oh, I was talking about Mr. Shahin who guards the place.

dialogues.speaker: Isami
dialogues.text: I've never seen such an inquisitive person in the Eremites.

dialogues.speaker: Isami
dialogues.text: I always thought the Eremites were a group of reserved brutes, but I was gravely mistaken.

dialogues.speaker: Isami
dialogues.text: I have nothing against friendly people, but he keeps asking about what's being done here and what's being stored there... It overwhelms me a little.

dialogues.speaker: Isami
dialogues.text: It's mainly because he looks so curious, so he doesn't seem like he's scheming something, and I can't bother matra for just a few questions of his...

dialogues.speaker: Isami
dialogues.text: So, I have to deal with him as best I can.

dialogues.speaker: Isami
dialogues.text: This is Pardis Dhyai, a research site for Amu{RUBY#[S]Biology}rta. You can meet researchers studying topics like plants, Shroom-Kin, and even insects here.

dialogues.speaker: Isami
dialogues.text: They're mostly researchers and students of the Akademiya, and some are close collaborators with Pardis Dhyai.

dialogues.speaker: Isami
dialogues.text: For example, a Forest Watcher of Gandharva Ville used to spend all his time here while he was studying. Even if he has left the Akademiya now, he still comes here often to conduct research.

dialogues.speaker: Isami
dialogues.text: His research findings are very precious, so Pardis Dhyai is willing to assist the Forest Rangers in their work too. Call it a mutually beneficial cooperation.
